capabilities: Browse notes in a Dendron tree view
Look up, open, create and delete notes by Dendron path
Generate frontmatter automatically for new notes
Add and remove multiple vaults in settings
Render wikilinks and embeds using Dendron format
disambiguation: Not a general file explorer; the tree, lookup and note creation all work on Dendron's dotted note paths.
extras: The custom Dendron-format resolver/renderer is disabled by default and, when enabled, forces all wikilinks and embeds to render with Dendron syntax.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer does not understand Dendron's dotted hierarchical note paths, so Dendron users lack a hierarchy-aware tree.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Dendron Tree adds a tree for exploring Dendron notes.

summary: Dendron-format tree view that browses, looks up, creates and deletes notes by their dotted Dendron path inside Obsidian.
